headline: A Night in Vice City. On the eve of the release of Grand Theft Auto VI, tune in to the NBA
body: A Night in Vice City. On the eve of the release of Grand Theft Auto VI, tune in to the NBA on ESPN Wednesday, November 18 at 7PM Eastern to see the HEAT trade Miami for Vice City when they host the Milwaukee Bucks. HEAT. com/ViceCity.
